title: growth-sprint sprint.json
description: The sprint plan the model writes and the founder approves once: one goal, a budget cap, a bounded graph of agent steps. Written by the model, checked by scripts/sprint.py validate (this schema, then the registry, the graph, the flags and the budget). Any change after approval invalidates the approval. Validate with: python3 shared/scripts/validate_json.py agents/growth-sprint/assets/sprint.schema.json <sprint.json>

label.description: Run label passed to the agent; fills <label> in the registry output paths.

brief.description: What this step must produce for the goal, in one or two sentences.

inputs.description: Values passed to the agent (names from its Inputs table).

spends.description: Must be true when the registry says the agent can spend.

publishes.description: Must be true when the registry says the agent can publish.

estimate_eur.description: Maximum cash this step may spend. 0 for local agents.

estimate_basis.description: Where the estimate comes from (the agent's own quote, the founder's provider price). Required when spends is true.

reuse_if_fresh_days.description: Skip the step when its outputs already exist, pass their checks and are this recent.

done_when.description: Extra end criterion for the report; the disk check of the registry always applies.

text.description: The founder's objective, in their words.

metric.description: What is counted to know the goal was met.

source.description: founder, or an experiment of a growth-pulse handoff: growth-pulse/experiments-<YYYYMMDD>.json#<experiment id>.

context_read.description: Project files read to build the plan.

cap_eur.description: Cap in EUR of cash spent on optional paid APIs from the founder's own accounts (image-model photo backgrounds, paid SERP calls); 0 means no paid call; never ad spend. Spent is what steps report, and above the cap the circuit breaker trips.

alert_ratio.description: Warn when spent reaches this share of the cap (default 0.8).

basis.description: Why this cap: the founder's figure or the sum of the step estimates.
